_comment: Taxonomy names already served by an existing product directory are not
duplicated here: eAvionics -> avionics, eSpace -> space_systems,
eUAV / eUAS / eDrone -> uav_drone_systems. Those four directories were
hand-authored before this catalog existed and are left untouched.

products.title: Flight Control Systems

readme.category: Fly-by-wire actuation and control law execution

products.overview: Triplex-redundant fly-by-wire flight control computer executing control laws for primary and secondary surfaces. Three dissimilar lanes vote on every actuator command, with a fourth monitor lane arbitrating disagreement. Each lane runs an independently compiled eOS RTOS image so a coding fault cannot propagate across the redundancy set.
specs: ARINC-429 x8, MIL-STD-1553B x2, CAN FD x4, 10BASE-T1L x2
DO-178C Level A software, DO-254 Level A hardware

bom.description: Cortex-M7 flight control lane processor (3 lanes, lockstep pairs)
FPGA I/O manager and cross-lane voter
MRAM for control law state, one per lane

products.title: Satellite Platform Avionics
products.overview: Radiation-hardened satellite platform computer for LEO and GEO buses, handling attitude determination and control, telemetry and telecommand, power management, and payload data routing. Built on a dual-core LEON3FT processor with an EDAC-protected memory subsystem and SpaceWire fabric to the payload.
specs: Microchip RTG4 RT4G150 rad-tolerant flash FPGA
2GB DDR4 with Reed-Solomon EDAC, 256kbit MRAM for critical state
MIL-STD-1553B dual redundant, CAN FD x2
pcb: Electroplated nickel-gold, staked and conformal coated
compliance: SpaceWire links, nodes, routers and networks

bom.description: Rad-tolerant FPGA, SpaceWire router and payload interface
MRAM for attitude state and boot configuration
Rad-hard LDO for analogue and reference rails
Inertial reference for coarse attitude determination

products.title: CubeSat Systems
products.overview: PC/104-compatible CubeSat avionics stack providing on-board computing, electrical power conditioning, and attitude determination for 1U through 12U missions. COTS-based rather than rad-hard, with watchdog-driven latch-up recovery and triple-redundant boot images sized for LEO missions of up to three years.
specs: iCE40UP5K FPGA watchdog and latch-up monitor
16MB QSPI NOR triple-redundant boot, 1Mbit FRAM state
pcb: Symmetric with dedicated analogue ground pour

bom.description: FRAM for mission state and counters
Solar string and rail current monitoring

products.title: Satellite Ground Station

readme.category: SDR ground segment, tracking and baseband

products.overview: Software-defined satellite ground station modem covering VHF through S-band, with CCSDS-compliant framing, Doppler-corrected tracking, and antenna rotator control. A Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC runs the demodulation chain in fabric while the application processor handles pass scheduling and TLE propagation.
specs: Zynq UltraScale+ XCZU3EG, quad Cortex-A53 + FPGA
pcb: Rogers RO4350B RF layers over FR-4 core

bom.description: JESD204B clock distribution and jitter cleaning

products.title: Launch Vehicle Avionics

readme.category: Launch vehicle flight computer and FTS

products.overview: Launch vehicle flight computer handling guidance, navigation and control from lift-off through payload separation, with an independent autonomous flight termination system on a physically separate board and power domain. Sized for small-lift vehicles with ascent phases under twelve minutes.
specs: ADIS16505 IMU triad + ZED-F9P GNSS, tightly coupled
Independent AFTS with dissimilar processor and battery
Qualified to 14.1 Grms random per NASA-STD-7001
pcb: Symmetric with isolated pyro return plane
ENIG, staked and bonded for vibration

bom.description: MRAM for trajectory and event log
GNC and AFTS boards, independently fabricated

products.title: Propulsion Control Systems
products.overview: Propulsion control unit for liquid bipropellant engines and electric thrusters, closing loops on chamber pressure, valve position, and mixture ratio. Handles throttle authority, ignition sequencing, and thermal margin protection, with hardware interlocks that inhibit ignition independently of software state.
specs: Dual-arm hardware interlock, software cannot bypass
compliance: Functional safety of the ignition interlock

bom.description: MRAM for burn log and fault state

power.label: ePCU-700 Propulsion Control Unit
loads: Valve solenoid drive (6 x 5A peak, 30% duty)

products.title: Air Traffic Management Systems
products.overview: Ground surveillance receiver combining 1090MHz ADS-B extended squitter, Mode-S multilateration, and UAT reception into a single fused track feed. Time-of-arrival stamping is disciplined to UTC by a GNSS-locked OCXO, giving the sub-10ns timing that wide-area multilateration requires.
specs: Zynq UltraScale+ XCZU3EG, pulse decode in fabric
400km line of sight for ADS-B ES
pcb: Rogers RO4350B RF layer over FR-4
ENIG with shielding cans over RF sections
compliance: Technical specification for ADS-B ground stations

bom.description: Pulse decode and track fusion MPSoC

products.title: Airport Ground Systems

readme.category: AGL control, stand guidance, apron sensing

products.overview: Airport ground infrastructure controller for airfield ground lighting, docking guidance, and apron surveillance. Individual lamp control and monitoring runs over a power-line carrier on the existing series circuit, avoiding the trenching that a parallel data network would require on a live airfield.
specs: TI AM6254 quad Cortex-A53 industrial SoC
Power-line carrier over 6.6A series circuit, 2048 fixtures
Individual lamp fault detection within 2 seconds
Dual GbE ring, RS-485 x4, CAN FD x2, 32 dry contacts
compliance: Constant current regulators for aeronautical lighting

products.title: Telemetry Systems
products.overview: Airborne and range telemetry encoder that samples analogue and digital instrumentation into an IRIG 106 PCM stream, applies CCSDS framing and forward error correction, then transmits on S-band. Handles 256 analogue channels with per-channel programmable sample rates and IRIG-B time correlation.
specs: AMD Xilinx Artix-7 XC7A100T, IRIG 106 Chapter 4 PCM
IRIG-B AM and DCLS, 1us to UTC

products.title: GNSS Receiver Systems
products.overview: Multi-constellation multi-band GNSS receiver with RTK and PPP correction support, tightly coupled inertial aiding, and interference detection. An ECP5 FPGA monitors the raw IF spectrum for jamming and spoofing signatures, so an attack is reported rather than silently degrading the position solution.
specs: GPS L1/L2/L5, Galileo E1/E5, GLONASS, BeiDou, QZSS
ECP5 FPGA spectral analysis, jamming and spoofing flags
UART x2, USB 2.0, CAN FD, 1PPS, event capture
pcb: Continuous RF ground under antenna feed
50 ohm RF trace to antenna port

bom.description: IF spectral monitor, jamming and spoofing detection
Industrial IMU for tightly coupled aiding
Low-noise LDO for RF front end

products.title: Inertial Navigation Systems
products.overview: Tactical-grade inertial navigation system providing a continuous position solution through GNSS outage, blending a triad of tactical IMUs with barometric, magnetic, and optional odometry aiding in an error-state Kalman filter. Drift is specified at under 1.5 nautical miles per hour of free inertial operation.
specs: GNSS, barometric, magnetic, odometry, air data
ARINC-429, MIL-STD-1553B, RS-422, CAN FD, Ethernet
pcb: Isolated IMU mounting island, thermally symmetric

bom.description: MRAM for alignment and calibration state

products.title: Space Weather Monitoring
products.overview: Space weather instrument package measuring energetic particle flux, total ionising dose, magnetic field, and ionospheric total electron content. Flown as a hosted payload or on a dedicated smallsat, feeding both spacecraft anomaly attribution and ground forecasting models.
specs: Silicon telescope, 0.1-100 MeV protons, 0.05-10 MeV electrons
RADFET total ionising dose, 0.1 rad resolution
pcb: Guarded analogue island for detector bias

bom.description: 24-bit low-noise ADC for detector and dosimetry

products.title: Radiation-Tolerant Electronics

readme.category: Rad-tolerant building blocks and SEE mitigation

products.overview: Radiation-tolerant building-block board set for missions that cannot afford full rad-hard silicon everywhere. Combines a rad-hard processor and antifuse FPGA core with latch-up-protected COTS peripherals, triple modular redundancy in fabric, and scrubbing of configuration memory.
specs: Triple modular redundancy with majority voting
Per-rail current limiters, 10us trip, autonomous retry
pcb: Selective tantalum spot shielding over sensitive die

bom.description: Rad-hard buck with latch-up current limiting
Rad-hard LDO for core and analogue rails
16-layer polyimide Class 3/A PCB with spot shielding
